{{Quote|I did not mean to draw comparisons between Katarr and Malachor&hellip; my homeworld still exists. It is&hellip; intact. The planet was not destroyed, it remains&hellip; it orbits, dead in space, but nothing lives on its surface. It echoes, but there is no one left to hear it.|[[Visas Marr]]|<ref name="KOTORII" />}}
'''Katarr''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It was completely [[Conclave at Katarr|devastated]] in [[3952 BBY]], during the [[First Jedi Purge]].

==Description==
[[File:Katarr.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A city on Katarr before the disaster.]]

Katarr was located in the [[Vensori sector/Legends|Vensori sector]] of the Mid Rim.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the sole colony world of the Miraluka, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Species/Legends|race]] that was only able to see through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Although its continents were almost entirely covered by mountains, it had rich flora and fauna, including birds and trees. The Miraluka of Katarr built their cities with a distinctive, round-shaped architectural style.<ref name="UU" />

==History==
{{Quote|My people never saw his face when he struck&mdash;but they heard his voice. When my lord spoke, every living thing on Katarr died. The destruction of Katarr echoed through the Force, the screaming of countless lives.|[[Visas Marr]]|<ref name="UU" />}}
[[File:Nihiluswalks.png|thumb|right|150px|Darth Nihilus encounters Visas Marr as he walks on the devastated surface of Katarr.]]

All life on Katarr was devoured by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] in approximately [[3952 BBY]].<ref name="Jedi vs Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> [[Conclave at Katarr|The attack]] was directed at a [[Conclave at Katarr|Jedi meeting]] being held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. From the entire planetary population, only one being, a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] named [[Visas Marr]], survived. Sometime after the destruction of [[Malachor V]], Visas returned to walk across the surface of Katarr.<ref name="UU" /> Although the primary motivation behind Nihilus' attack was obviously to devour the Jedi, the fact that Katarr was located almost half-way between [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], two key [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] worlds, led some to believe that the [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith]] wanted to blind that section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], possibly to allow them to make it easier to hide their movements from the Republic.<ref name="KOTORII" />
